entities.summary: Dimitri Anatolyevich Riabykin is a Russian former professional ice hockey defenceman who played in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by Calgary Flames in the second round of the 1994 NHL Entry Draft. He most formerly the head coach for HC Vityaz and Avangard Omsk in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
